topic_ko: 더블린에서 맞은 첫 등교일 — 교복과 넥타이, 친구들의 짓궂은 질문, 프랑스와 다른 점심시간

passage: Delphine woke with a start on the morning of her first day at an Irish school.
The house was in uproar as four children hunted for shoes and bags at once.
Her host mother had already laid out a school uniform for her.
It fitted well, though Dara had to knot the school tie for her.
On the way she was pleased and frightened in equal measure.
One of Dara's friends asked whether she was his girlfriend, and both of them blushed.
At lunch she was astonished to find that pupils ate at their own desks.
She did not follow every question the others asked, but the day was an enjoyable one.
choices: the strict discipline enforced in Irish secondary schools
the difficulty of making friends in a foreign classroom
the differences between French and Irish school uniforms
a first school day in which small surprises outweigh the awkward moments
the importance of learning a language before studying abroad
theme.explanation_ko: 당황한 순간이 있었으나 마지막을 '즐거운 하루'로 맺으므로, 작은 놀라움들이 어색함을 덮은 첫 등교일을 다룬 ④가 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ① 규율을 다루지 않는다. ② 친구 사귀기의 어려움이 아니라 오히려 많은 아이들이 말을 걸었다. ③ 교복은 소재의 하나일 뿐이다. ⑤ 언어 준비를 주장하지 않는다.

passage: The whole household was hectic on the morning of Delphine's first school day.
Ms. O'Brien checked that none of the children had crawled back into bed.
A uniform was waiting for the guest, and Dara tied her school tie for her.
She felt delighted and nervous at the same time as they walked to school.
A boy asked whether she was Dara's girlfriend, and she denied it at once.
Both of them were left looking thoroughly embarrassed.
The rest of the day passed smoothly, apart from a lunch break spent at the desks.
Much of the talk went over her head, and still she enjoyed herself.
choices: 낯선 학교의 하루는 당황스러운 순간까지 포함해 새로운 경험이 된다.
교복은 학생들 사이의 차이를 없애는 가장 효과적인 수단이다.
외국어를 못 알아들으면 학교생활에 적응하기 어렵다.
점심시간의 길이는 학업 성취도에 직접적인 영향을 준다.
친구의 오해는 되도록 빨리 바로잡는 것이 좋다.
gist.explanation_ko: 모든 것을 알아듣지는 못했지만 재미있었다고 맺으므로, 당황까지 포함한 하루가 새로운 경험이 되었다는 ①이 요지이다.
gist.distractor_ko: ② 교복의 기능을 논하지 않는다. ③ 알아듣지 못했어도 즐거웠다고 했으므로 정반대이다. ④ 점심시간 길이는 비교 소재일 뿐이다. ⑤ 오해 정정은 한 장면에 그친다.

passage: A beeping alarm pulled Delphine out of sleep on her first Irish school morning.
Four children rushed about the house while their mother checked nobody had gone back to bed.
She put on the uniform that had been left out for her.
Dara had to help with the tie, which she had never worn before.
At the gates a boy asked if she was his girlfriend, and both went red.
Lessons went smoothly until the lunch break arrived.
To her surprise, everyone stayed at their desks to eat.
She missed much of what was said, and enjoyed the day all the same.
choices: How to Wear an Irish School Uniform
The Longest Lunch Break in Europe
Making Friends Without Speaking a Word
A Tie, a Teasing Question and Lunch at the Desk
title.explanation_ko: 넥타이·짓궂은 질문·책상에서의 점심이 이 글의 세 장면을 그대로 요약하므로 ⑤가 제목으로 적절하다.
title.distractor_ko: ① 착용법 안내가 아니다. ② 점심시간은 오히려 짧았다. ③ 말을 하지 않은 것이 아니라 많은 질문을 받았다. ④ 알람은 첫 문장에만 나온다.

passage: Delphine was in Dara's class because the two of them were both sixteen.
On the way to school she was both delighted and nervous.
When they arrived, some of Dara's friends looked at her and smiled.
"Is this your girlfriend, Dara?" one of them asked.
"I'm not his girlfriend!" Delphine quickly replied, feeling a bit embarrassed.
Dara looked embarrassed, too.
After that, the rest of the school day went smoothly.
Many kids asked Delphine about life in France, and she enjoyed it.
choices: Dara was annoyed that his friends had interrupted the morning.
Dara had been hoping that nobody would notice the new student.
The teasing question left Dara as uncomfortable as it left Delphine.
Dara regretted having introduced Delphine to his classmates.
Dara wanted to correct his friends but could not find the words.
implication.explanation_ko: too 는 앞 문장의 Delphine 과 같은 상태였음을 뜻하므로, 그 질문이 Dara 도 똑같이 불편하게 했다는 ③이 맞다.
implication.distractor_ko: ① 짜증이 아니라 당황이다. ② 눈에 띄지 않기를 바랐다는 근거가 없다. ④ 후회했다는 서술이 없다. ⑤ 바로잡으려 했다는 내용은 Delphine 쪽이다.

passage: The entire household was hectic on the morning of her first day.
All the kids rushed to get ready for school, with Ms. O'Brien checking on them.
A uniform had been left out, and it suited her well.
Dara had to help her with the school tie before they set off.
Delphine was both delighted and nervous on the way to school.
She was surprised to find students eat at their desks during the break.
Uniforms are normal in Irish schools, with ties wearing by both boys and girls.
The lunch break lasts an hour, half the two-hour break she had in France.
grammar.explanation_ko: ② 넥타이는 착용되는 대상이므로 with 분사구문에서 과거분사를 써야 한다. wearing → worn 이 되어야 한다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ① 부인이 확인하는 능동 관계로 옳다. ③ both A and B 병렬로 옳다. ④ find 의 목적격보어 원형부정사로 옳다. ⑤ 하이픈 복합형용사로 옳다.

passage: A beeping alarm woke Delphine with a shock that morning.
The whole house was hectic as everyone hurried to get ready.
The uniform suited her well once the tie had been knotted.
Walking to school she felt delighted and nervous at the same time.
A teasing question left her feeling a little embraced in front of the others.
The rest of the day went smoothly except during the lunch break.
She was surprised to find that pupils ate at their own desks.
The break lasts only an hour, half of what she was used to at home.
vocab.explanation_ko: ③ 짓궂은 질문에 느낀 감정은 당황(embarrassed)이다. embraced(껴안긴)는 문맥과 전혀 맞지 않는다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ① 분주한 아침으로 옳다. ② 교복이 어울렸다는 뜻으로 옳다. ④ 순조롭게 지나갔다는 뜻으로 옳다. ⑤ 한 시간 지속된다는 뜻으로 옳다.

passage: Delphine had expected her first Irish school day to feel entirely foreign.
The uniform was new to her, and so was the tie Dara had to knot.
A boy's teasing question left both her and Dara red in the face.
Yet the lessons themselves passed without difficulty.
What genuinely astonished her came at midday: ______________________.
In France she would have left the room for a two-hour meal.
Here the pupils simply stayed where they were and opened their lunches.
The break was over in an hour, and the afternoon began.
choices: the teachers ate together with their own classes
students had their lunch at their desks in the classroom
nobody was allowed to speak during the meal
the school served a four-course meal to everyone
lunch was eaten standing up in the corridor
blank.explanation_ko: 빈칸 뒤에서 프랑스와 달리 '학생들이 있던 자리에 그대로 앉아 도시락을 열었다'고 하므로 ②가 맞다.
blank.distractor_ko: ① 교사 이야기는 없다. ③ 말을 못 하게 했다는 서술이 없다(오히려 많이 물었다). ④ 4코스 식사는 프랑스 쪽 이야기다. ⑤ 복도에서 서서 먹지 않았다.

irrelevant.intro: Delphine woke with a shock to a beeping sound on her first day at school in Dublin.
sentences: The whole house was hectic as the children rushed to get ready for the morning.
Ms. O'Brien had a school uniform waiting, though Dara had to help with the tie.
St. Patrick was the patron saint who brought Christianity to Ireland in the 5th century.
At the gates a friend asked whether she was Dara's girlfriend, and both were embarrassed.
The rest of the day went smoothly, and many pupils asked her about life in France.
irrelevant.explanation_ko: ③은 성 패트릭의 유래에 관한 진술로, 첫 등교일의 하루라는 흐름과 무관하다.
irrelevant.distractor_ko: ①②는 등교 준비, ④⑤는 학교에서의 장면으로 모두 시간 순서에 맞게 이어진다.

order.given: Delphine woke up with a shock to a beeping sound. She was excited because this was her first day at school in Dublin.

blocks.A: The whole house was hectic that morning, and Ms. O'Brien checked that none of the children had gone back to sleep. A uniform was waiting for the guest, though Dara had to knot the tie for her.
blocks.B: At the gates one of his friends asked whether she was his girlfriend. She denied it at once, and both of them were left thoroughly embarrassed.
blocks.C: After that the lessons went smoothly, and only the lunch break surprised her. Pupils ate at their desks, and many of them asked her about life in France.

order.explanation_ko: 기상 후 (A) 등교 준비 → (B) 학교 도착 직후의 질문 → (C) 그 이후의 수업과 점심 순서이므로 ①이다.
order.distractor_ko: (C)가 'After that'으로 시작해 앞선 사건을 전제하므로 맨 앞에 올 수 없고, 교복을 입는 (A)가 학교 도착보다 먼저여야 한다.

passage_marked.text: Delphine was both delighted and nervous on the way to school that morning.
When they arrived, some of Dara's friends looked at her and smiled.
"Is this your girlfriend, Dara?" one of them asked.
"I'm not his girlfriend!" she replied quickly, feeling a bit embarrassed.
After that, the rest of the school day went smoothly.

insert.explanation_ko: ④에 넣어야 Delphine 이 당황했다는 문장 바로 뒤에서 too 가 '그도 마찬가지였다'로 자연스럽게 이어진다.
insert.distractor_ko: ①②③은 아직 당황할 사건이 벌어지기 전이라 too 가 받을 대상이 없고, ⑤는 이미 장면이 마무리된 뒤라 늦다.

passage: Delphine's first Irish school day began with a beeping alarm and a hectic house.
A uniform was waiting, but the school tie defeated her until Dara stepped in.
She walked to school delighted and nervous at once.
A friend's teasing question left both her and Dara embarrassed.
The lessons themselves gave her no trouble at all.
At midday she discovered that pupils eat at their desks, unlike in France.
Her lunch break lasted an hour instead of the two she was used to.
She missed a good deal of the conversation, and still called it a fun day.
summary.summary_template: Delphine's first day brought several __(A)__ customs and one embarrassing moment, but she still found the day __(B)__.
summary.explanation_ko: 교복·넥타이·책상 점심 모두 낯선(unfamiliar) 관습이었지만 마지막을 'It was a fun day'로 맺으므로 ②가 맞다.
summary.distractor_ko: familiar 는 놀랐다는 서술과 어긋나고, exhausting·disappointing 은 '재미있었다'는 결말과 맞지 않는다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: Delphine은 학교로 가는 길에 기쁘면서도 긴장되었다.
writing.answer: Delphine was both delighted and nervous on the way to school.
writing.explanation_ko: both A and B 는 상반된 두 형용사를 나란히 묶는다.

writing.question: 다음 조건에 맞게 우리말을 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: Delphine은 학생들이 자기 책상에서 밥을 먹는 것을 발견하고 놀랐다.
conditions: be surprised to 를 쓸 것
find 의 목적격보어로 원형부정사를 쓸 것
writing.answer: Delphine was surprised to find students eat at their desks.
writing.explanation_ko: 감정 형용사 뒤의 to부정사는 원인을 나타내고, find 는 목적격보어로 원형부정사를 취한다.

writing.question: 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 넣어 문장을 완성하시오.
writing.template: Ties are ______ by both male and female pupils.
writing.explanation_ko: 넥타이가 착용되는 대상이므로 수동의 과거분사 worn 을 쓴다.

writing.question: 다음 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: She didn't understand everything, but it was fun.
writing.answer: 그녀는 모든 것을 이해하지는 못했지만, 그것은 재미있었다.
writing.explanation_ko: not + everything 은 부분부정으로 "모두 ~한 것은 아니다"로 옮긴다.

writing.question: 본문을 한 문장으로 요약할 때 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.summary: Delphine was both delighted and __(A)__ on her first school day, and although one question left her embarrassed, the day was __(B)__.
writing.explanation_ko: 본문은 both delighted and nervous 라고 했고, 마지막을 It was a fun day 로 맺는다.

writing.question: 글의 주제를 한 문장으로 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 낯선 학교의 첫날은 당황스러운 순간까지 포함해 새로운 경험이 된다.
writing.answer: A first day at a new school becomes a fresh experience, embarrassing moments included.
writing.explanation_ko: become 을 써서 경험이 된다는 흐름을 만들고, 부대 요소는 뒤에 덧붙인다.
